comparison.objective: Safely feed a rubber strip into a roller mill, versus tune and lock a shock absorber through repeated test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-to-run actuation, deformable feeding, timely release, and nip avoidance versus rigid fine-tool manipulation and response-guided collar adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Strip drawn through and dropped on tray with hand ≥5 cm from the energized nip versus two quantified non-bottoming stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both include guarded physical control actuation, but their central tested abilities—safe deformable feeding versus mechanical damping commissioning—are different.
